<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

The `image-pushing` Makefile target is replaced with two named targets: `image-pushing-periodic` (debug, importer, ray-mini images) and `image-pushing-postsubmit` (main images, Helm chart, kueueviz/populator/priority-booster). A new `cloudbuild-periodic.yaml` is added to invoke the periodic target; `cloudbuild.yaml` is updated to invoke the postsubmit target.

## Changes

**Image Push Target Split and Cloud Build Wiring**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Makefile: new periodic and postsubmit targets** <br> `Makefile` | Removes `image-pushing`, `image-pushing-helper-artifacts`, and `image-pushing-release-artifacts`. Adds `.PHONY image-pushing-periodic` with dependencies `debug-image-push`, `importer-image-push`, `ray-project-mini-image-build-push`. Adds `.PHONY image-pushing-postsubmit` with dependencies `image-push`, `helm-chart-push`, `kueueviz-image-push`, `kueue-populator-image-push`, `kueue-priority-booster-image-push`. |
| **Cloud Build configs: periodic added, postsubmit updated** <br> `cloudbuild-periodic.yaml`, `cloudbuild.yaml` | `cloudbuild-periodic.yaml` is a new file that runs `make image-pushing-periodic` on `E2_HIGHCPU_32` with a 3600s timeout and configures `_GIT_TAG`/`_PULL_BASE_REF` substitutions. `cloudbuild.yaml` switches its build step argument from `image-pushing` to `image-pushing-postsubmit`. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~5 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12113](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12113): Introduced the `ray-project-mini-image-build-push` Makefile target that is now listed as a dependency of `image-pushing-periodic`.
- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12304](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12304): Previously refactored the same `image-pushing` target with periodic/postsubmit branching and helper/release-artifacts targets that this PR now removes.
